title: Nondeterministic log space and its complement
statement: Let $\mathrm{NL}$ be the class of languages decidable by a finite nondeterministic Turing machine using at most a constant multiple of $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$ work-tape cells on inputs of length $n$. Let $\mathrm{coNL}$ be the class of languages whose complements belong to $\mathrm{NL}$. Then $\mathrm{NL}=\mathrm{coNL}$.
